metadata.name: baseline-placeholder-calibration
metadata.description: Executable baseline values for the dairy ABM. Defaults marked assumption=true require later calibration before scientific use.

cross_diet_repeatability_modifier.description: Midpoint default for cross-diet RFI expression repeatability.

minimum_intake_record_days.description: Minimum continuous intake records before reliable RFI_fat assignment.

annual_rfi_gain_fraction.description: Midpoint of supported annual gain range for RFI-supported traits.

selection_intensity.description: Share of eligible breeding candidates selected each annual cycle.

phenotypic_sd_rfi_fat.description: Phenotypic standard deviation scaled to the blueprint's annual 0.75-1.0 percent RFI gain target.

generation_interval_years.description: Generation interval required to annualize breeder-equation gain.

offspring_trait_variation_fraction.description: Seeded random variation around the parental mean for prospective offspring trait vectors.

feed_cost_stress_threshold_per_kg_dm.description: Feed-cost signal threshold that increases feed-efficiency selection emphasis.

feed_efficiency_weight_multiplier_under_.description: Feed-efficiency weight multiplier applied when feed cost exceeds the configured stress threshold.

disease_frequency_stress_threshold.description: Disease-pressure threshold that increases health selection emphasis.

health_weight_multiplier_under_disease_s.description: Health weight multiplier applied when active disease cases exceed the stress threshold.

low_cull_price_threshold.description: Cull-price threshold below which survivability receives additional breeding emphasis.

survivability_weight_multiplier_under_lo.description: Survivability weight multiplier applied when the cull-price signal is low.

milk_yield.description: Baseline breeding-index weight for milk production.

feed_efficiency.description: Baseline breeding-index weight for low RFI and feed efficiency.

health.description: Baseline breeding-index weight for disease resilience.

base_milk_l_per_cow_day.description: Baseline daily milk production before health, genetics, and heat-stress modifiers.

enteric_ch4_kg_per_cow_day.description: Baseline enteric methane emission before feed-efficiency adjustment.

heat_stress_milk_loss_fraction.description: Milk reduction when heat stress is active.

pregnancy_rate_monthly.description: Baseline monthly pregnancy probability for eligible cows.

initial_age_days.description: Default age assigned to a simulated cow when a scenario does not provide one.

initial_days_in_milk.description: Default lactation day assigned when a scenario does not provide one.

initial_parity.description: Default completed-lactation count assigned when a scenario does not provide one.

initial_body_weight_kg.description: Default body weight assigned when a scenario does not provide one.

initial_body_condition_score.description: Default body-condition score assigned when a scenario does not provide one.

mild_heat_stress_thi.description: THI threshold at which mild heat-stress effects begin.

severe_heat_stress_thi.description: THI threshold at which severe heat-stress effects begin.

mild_heat_stress_dmi_loss_fraction.description: DMI reduction applied in the mild THI band.

severe_heat_stress_dmi_loss_fraction.description: DMI reduction applied above the severe THI threshold.

mild_heat_stress_milk_loss_fraction.description: Milk reduction applied in the mild THI band.

severe_heat_stress_milk_loss_fraction.description: Milk reduction applied above the severe THI threshold.

sara_rumen_ph_threshold.description: Rumen pH below which subacute ruminal acidosis is tracked.

sara_consecutive_ticks.description: Consecutive low-pH observations required before SARA production effects apply.

sara_dmi_loss_fraction.description: DMI reduction applied to cows affected by sustained SARA.

sara_milk_loss_fraction.description: Milk reduction applied to cows affected by sustained SARA.

reproduction_eligibility_days_in_milk.description: Minimum lactation day before a non-pregnant cow enters the reproduction pool.

ration_shortfall_milk_loss_fraction.description: Milk-production reduction per unit of unmet prior-day ration coverage.

grazing_intake_kg_dm_per_ha_day.description: Dry-matter intake contribution from pasture grazing per hectare.

milk_protein_fraction.description: Milk protein mass represented per litre of simulated milk.

replacement_maturity_days.description: Age at which a female replacement enters first lactation in the simplified lifecycle.

lactation_peak_days.description: Peak-day parameter for the normalized Wood-style lactation curve.

initial_feed_inventory_kg_dm.description: Opening on-farm feed inventory when a scenario does not provide one.

initial_soil_n_kg.description: Opening plant-available soil nitrogen when a scenario does not provide one.

local_feed_crude_protein_fraction.description: Crude-protein fraction assigned to locally produced feed dry matter.

imported_feed_crude_protein_fraction.description: Crude-protein fraction assigned to imported feed dry matter.

metabolizable_protein_fraction_of_crude_.description: Share of ration crude protein represented as metabolizable protein.

nitrogen_fraction_of_crude_protein.description: Nitrogen mass fraction represented by ration crude protein.

ration_cost_per_kg_dm.description: Baseline ration cost used when no market packet overrides feed cost.

nutrient_return_efficiency.description: Fraction of manure nutrients credited back to crop production.

nutrient_loop_feed_substitution_fraction.description: Share of compost mass credited as avoided purchased feed in the nutrient loop.

seasonal_yield_modifier.description: Seasonal multiplier on baseline crop yield; scenario can override per month.

catch_crop_n_leaching_fraction.description: Fraction of plant-available soil nitrogen lost to leaching per day.

metabolizable_energy_mj_per_kg_dm.description: Metabolizable energy content of ration dry matter.

neutral_detergent_fiber_fraction.description: Neutral-detergent fibre fraction of ration dry matter.

digester_route_fraction.description: Share of manure routed to anaerobic digestion.

compost_route_fraction.description: Share of manure routed to composting.

storage_route_fraction.description: Share of manure routed to storage.

biochemical_methane_potential_m3_per_kg_.description: Biochemical methane potential for digested manure.

volatile_solids_fraction.description: Volatile solids fraction in wet manure.

collection_efficiency.description: Fraction of cow manure captured by the managed manure system.

storage_capacity_kg.description: Managed manure storage capacity used for inventory and overflow checks.

storage_release_fraction.description: Daily fraction of stored manure released from inventory; zero retains storage until a later policy path is added.

uncollected_ch4_kg_per_kg_manure.description: Methane loss factor for manure outside managed collection.

urinary_n_excess_fraction.description: Share of feed nitrogen above metabolizable-protein supply assigned to urinary nitrogen.

digestate_n_retention_fraction.description: Retained nitrogen fraction for the digester nutrient-return package.

compost_n_retention_fraction.description: Retained nitrogen fraction for the compost nutrient-return package.

phosphorus_to_nitrogen_fraction.description: Placeholder phosphorus-to-nitrogen ratio for route-specific nutrient packages.

potassium_to_nitrogen_fraction.description: Placeholder potassium-to-nitrogen ratio for route-specific nutrient packages.

thermochemical_route_fraction.description: Share of digester-routed manure diverted to the optional thermochemical route.

thermochemical_biochar_yield_fraction.description: Biochar yield retained as a physical reporting output until externally calibrated.

thermochemical_syngas_kwh_per_kg.description: Syngas energy yield retained as a physical reporting output until externally calibrated.

l3_energy_loop_enabled.description: Enable biogas energy generation from digested manure.

electricity_price_per_kwh.description: Static electricity value when no market packet is available.

heat_value_per_kwh.description: Static heat value for recovered energy.

parasitic_load_fraction.description: Fraction of generated energy consumed by system operation.

grid_offset_kg_co2e_per_kwh.description: Avoided grid emissions credit for exported electricity.

farm_energy_demand_kwh_per_day.description: Fallback farm electricity demand used for demand-capped displacement reporting.

heat_mj_per_kwh.description: Optional heat conversion coefficient; zero denotes unavailable external calibration.

milk_loss_sick_fraction.description: Milk production reduction for sick cows.

transmission_daily_probability.description: Per-infected-cow daily transmission contribution in the simplified SIR model.

disease_mortality_daily_probability.description: Disease-specific mortality probability; zero until calibrated.

quarantine_enabled.description: Whether infected cows are flagged for quarantine.

quarantine_effectiveness_fraction.description: Reduction in infectious transmission contribution from quarantined cows.

biosecurity_effectiveness_fraction.description: Maximum transmission reduction applied by scenario biosecurity level.

vaccination_effectiveness_fraction.description: Reduction in infection probability for vaccinated cows.

inherited_resistance_effectiveness_fract.description: Additional reduction in infection probability per unit health trait above baseline.

stress_susceptibility_multiplier.description: Multiplier applied to infection probability for cows under active stress (heat, SARA).

herd_density_transmission_multiplier.description: Multiplier on transmission pressure based on herd density relative to an operational reference. Values >1 amplify transmission in dense herds.

ch4_gwp100.description: Methane GWP100 factor used for reporting.

n2o_gwp100.description: Nitrous oxide GWP100 factor used for reporting.

field_n2o_kg_n2o_per_kg_n.description: Conversion of Manure field-N2O precursor into an Environment ledger stream.

fertilizer_n_kg_co2e_per_kg_n.description: Avoided-emission factor for recycled nitrogen displacing synthetic fertilizer.

circularity_weight_energy.description: Circularity score weight for energy recovery.

circularity_weight_nutrients.description: Circularity score weight for nutrient recycling.

circularity_weight_water.description: Circularity score weight for water reuse.

circularity_weight_products.description: Circularity score weight for by-product/product routing.

cofeed_safety_approved.description: Allow safety-approved co-feed inputs to manure energy routes.

coproduct_feed_allowed.description: Allow dairy coproducts to return to the feed system.

thermochemical_route_active.description: Enable optional thermochemical manure valorization routes.

discount_rate_annual.description: Annual discount rate for ROI calculations.

carbon_credit_price_per_tonne_co2e.description: Optional carbon credit price; zero by default.

objective_weight_profit.description: Farm-manager objective weight for profit maximisation.

objective_weight_environment.description: Farm-manager objective weight for environmental performance.

objective_weight_animal_welfare.description: Farm-manager objective weight for animal health and welfare.

objective_weight_circularity.description: Farm-manager objective weight for circular-economy performance.

alert_sensitivity.description: Threshold for converting abnormal readings into alerts.

missing_reading_probability.description: Daily probability of a missing sensor reading.

ambient_temperature_c.description: Fallback ambient temperature when no scenario weather input is supplied.

relative_humidity_pct.description: Fallback relative humidity when no scenario weather input is supplied.

rumen_ph_baseline.description: Fallback rumen-pH reading when no bolus value is supplied.

bolus_replacement_ticks.description: Bolus age at which replacement is due within the blueprint's 80-90 tick guidance.

sara_consecutive_ticks.description: Consecutive low-pH readings required for a sensor SARA-risk flag.

estrus_activity_threshold.description: Activity threshold used by the simplified estrus detector.

estrus_rumination_change_threshold.description: Rumination-change threshold used by the simplified estrus detector.

nir_crude_protein_fraction.description: Fallback NIR crude-protein profile used when no external feed scan is supplied.

thermal_mastitis_alert_confidence.description: Minimum blueprint-supported confidence for optional thermal mastitis alerts.

rumination_baseline_minutes_per_day.description: Baseline daily rumination time per cow.

nir_seasonality_modifier_fraction.description: Seasonal adjustment to NIR feed CP fraction; zero denotes no seasonality.

l2_water_loop_enabled.description: Enable recovered-water credits for next-day irrigation demand.

treatment_recovery_fraction.description: Fraction of wastewater recovered for reuse.

treatment_active.description: Enable on-farm wastewater treatment and physical reuse reporting.

wastewater_return_fraction.description: Share of cleaning-water demand collected as treatable wastewater.

amino_acid_policy_active_default.description: Preserves the existing baseline water-saving assumption unless a scenario overrides amino-acid policy activity.

nutrient_recovery_enabled.description: Publish optional wastewater nutrient-recovery packets when an external recovery coefficient is configured.

nutrient_recovery_kg_n_per_l.description: Optional nutrient-recovery coefficient; zero denotes unavailable external calibration.

water_loop_fresh_water_offset_fraction.description: Share of recovered water credited against next-day freshwater irrigation demand.

l4_byproduct_loop_enabled.description: Enable whey-derived feed credits for the following day.

enabled.description: Processor route is off by default while the agent remains available.

whey_processing_enabled.description: Whey route is off by default.

product_mix_cheese.description: Default product mix share for cheese.

product_mix_butter.description: Default product mix share for butter.

product_mix_yogurt.description: Default product mix share for yogurt.

product_mix_fresh.description: Default product mix share for fresh milk.

product_mix_functional.description: Default product mix share for functional products.

processing_energy_kwh_per_l_milk.description: Processor energy use when processor route is enabled.

milk_cooling_kwh_per_l_milk.description: Bulk-tank cooling energy for all harvested milk.

fraction_milk_to_processor.description: Share of harvested milk entering the opted-in processor.

whey_yield_cheese.description: Whey generated by the cheese milk stream.

whey_yield_yogurt.description: Whey generated by the yogurt milk stream.

whey_yield_functional.description: Whey generated by the functional milk stream.

fraction_sludge_of_milk.description: Processor sludge generated per litre of processed milk.

fraction_waste_milk_of_milk.description: Waste milk generated per litre of processed milk.

price_per_l_milk_cheese.description: Static cheese-stream value when a product price packet is absent.

price_per_l_milk_butter.description: Static butter-stream value when a product price packet is absent.

price_per_l_milk_yogurt.description: Static yogurt-stream value when a product price packet is absent.

price_per_l_milk_fresh.description: Static fresh-milk stream value when a product price packet is absent.

price_per_l_milk_functional.description: Static functional-product stream value when a product price packet is absent.

byproduct_loop_feed_substitution_kg_per_.description: Feed offset credited per kilogram of whey in the byproduct loop.

whey_liquid_price_per_l.description: Value booked for safety-approved liquid whey feed return.

fraction_whey_to_feed.description: Share of whey routed to the animal-feed loop when enabled.

fraction_sludge_to_energy.description: Share of processor sludge routed to energy.

fraction_waste_milk_to_feed.description: Share of waste milk routed to feed when safety allows.

milk_price_per_l.description: Static farm-gate milk price when CSV market data is absent.

feed_cost_per_kg_dm.description: Static feed cost when CSV market data is absent.

cull_cow_price.description: Static cull-cow value for management and genetics signals.

price_shock_stddev_fraction.description: Optional stochastic price shock standard deviation; disabled by default.

class_cwt_to_l_conversion.description: Explicit conversion placeholder for class price to volume price; must be validated before use.

silvopastoral_tree_cover_fraction.description: Dashboard range for silvopastoral tree cover.

soil_carbon_sequestration_index.description: Dashboard range for soil-carbon sequestration index.

monthly_report_day.description: Monthly reports emit on calendar month end.

annual_genetics_day.description: Annual genetics cycle emits on calendar year end.
